title: alchemilla glabra var. lineata
intro: Alchemilla glabra var. lineata, commonly known as the Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include its ability to soothe and calm menstrual cramps, reduce inflammation, and support wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Alchemilla glabra var. lineata include its anti-inflammatory, astringent, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various skin issues and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
